title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.31056v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. en_tdlr: DKnown-Jev-2 is an article-level answer-evidence classifier that jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, using a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence and Non-answer Evidence in a single forward pass, achieving 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1 on a 972-instance manually annotated test set while outperforming the Jev baseline.
